title: Stability of steady transonic shocks with constant states in 3D rectangular nozzles under small external forces
summary: This paper investigates the stability of steady transonic shocks with constant states in rectangular nozzles under small three dimensional perturbations of the external force and the exit pressure. Mathematically, the problem can be formulated as a nonlinear free boundary problem for a hyperbolic-elliptic coupled PDE system. One of the key difficulties lies in the arbitrary location of the background shock, which may lead to multiple shock solutions for the same external force and exit pressure under perturbations, revealing the instability of the background shock.
